but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work— neither you, nor your son, nor…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: Additionally, men of Tyre who lived there were importing fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them on the Sabbath to the people of Judah in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
translations.asv: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, who brought in fish, and all manner of wares, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
